_doc: Games that have had their QA pass (tools/prepublish-check.sh clean: game-lint, every module connected, tests/walk.mjs walks every screen clean, README status block). tests/game-quality.test.js holds only these games to it. Owner 2026-11-11: no sweep of every game — each game gets its pass the next time it is worked on (see the 'QA pass pending' note at the top of its README), then is added here.
